BORROWER IS A LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY AND NOT A NATURAL PERSON, AND BECAUSE NEITHER BORROWER NOR BORROWER'S IMMEDIATE FAMILY RESIDE IN THE MORTGAGED PREMISES, THE MORTGAGE IS A "NON-RESIDENTIAL MORTGAGE" UNDER THE FAIR FORECLOSURE ACT, PL. 195, C. 244. UNDER THE ACT, "RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY" MEANS REAL PROPERTY LOCATED IN THIS STATE [IN WHICH PEOPLE RESIDE OR DWELL AS THEIR PRIMARY RESIDENCE,] UTILIZED AS A PRIMARY RESIDENCE OR DWELLING, AND SHALL NOT INCLUDE ANY REAL PROPERTY WHICH IS [USED] ACQUIRED FOR INVESTMENT, COMMERCIAL, OR BUSINESS PURPOSES OR 2[RESIDENTIAL] REAL PROPERTY CONTAINING MORE THAN FOUR RESIDENTIAL UNITS.
THE COMMUNITY WEALTH PRESERVATION PROGRAM (CWPP) SOLELY APPLIES TO "RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES" WHICH ARE DEFINED AS REAL PROPERTY WITHIN THE STATE THAT IS "...UTILIZED AS A PRIMARY RESIDENCE OR DWELLING". THE CWPP EXPRESSLY EXCLUDES REAL PROPERTY THAT IS ACQUIRED FOR "INVESTMENT, COMMERCIAL OR BUSINESS PURPOSES OR REAL PROPERTY CONTAINING MORE THAN FOUR RESIDENTIAL UNITS."
